provenance.tokens-only-note: packages/core/src/menu (Menu/MenuBase/MenuTrigger/MenuPanel/MenuItem/MenuGroup) and packages/lab/src/{cascading-menu,menu-button} are ALL real, live, fully-inspectable Salt components — every cell below is [S] unless individually marked [R]. See DROPDOWN-MENU-MATRIX.md §0 for how the three directories relate.
provenance.trigger-bg / -fg / -bg-hover / -bg-activ: MenuButtonTrigger wraps a real Button with variant="secondary" (MenuButton.tsx). variantToAppearanceAndColor('secondary') -> {appearance:'transparent', sentiment:'neutral'} (Button.tsx:104-113) -> class .saltButton-neutral.saltButton-transparent -> --button-background: --salt-actionable-subtle-background = transparent; --button-text-color: --salt-actionable-subtle-foreground -> palette-foreground-primary -> black/white; --button-background-hover: --salt-actionable-subtle-background-hover -> palette-alpha-contrast-lower -> black-10a/white-10a = rgba(0,0,0,0.1)/rgba(255,255,255,0.1) (next/characteristics/actionable.css:67, next/palette/alpha.css:19,51, legacy/deprecated/foundations.css:45,50 for the -Na chain); --button-background-active: --salt-actionable-subtle-background-active -> palette-alpha-contrast-low -> black-15a/white-15a = rgba(...,0.15) (actionable.css:66, alpha.css:18,50).
provenance.trigger-open-is-a-dead-reference: MenuButtonTrigger.css's own --saltMenuButton-trigger-open-background/-color fallback to --salt-actionable-primary-background-active/-foreground-active, which are defined ONLY in packages/theme/css/legacy/deprecated/characteristics.css as aliases for --salt-actionable-bold-background-active/-foreground-active (CHANGELOG.md confirms this is a documented rename). Under the 'next' theme this pipeline pins everywhere, the property is undefined, so the var() falls through and NO extra colour applies — the trigger's real open-state background is Button.css's own generic [aria-expanded="true"][aria-haspopup="menu"] rule, which reassigns --button-background-active/-text-color-active — i.e. the SAME slot as :active/:focus-visible:active. style.trigger.background@open therefore aliases trigger-bg-active, not a dedicated 'open' colour. See DROPDOWN-MENU-MATRIX.md finding 1.
provenance.trigger-shape / -padding / -font: Button.css border-radius: palette-corner-weak (rounded-edition pin, curve-100, 2/4/6/8px by density — the SAME slot every other Salt column's trigger/control shape uses). padding: 0 calc(spacing-100 - button-borderWidth), border-width fixed at size-fixed-100=1px -> 0 (spacing-100-1)px by density. font: --salt-text-fontSize/-fontWeight/-fontFamily/-lineHeight (the general body role — Button.css's own action-role tokens resolve to the SAME numeric values as the body role at every density in this theme), reusing the type-body slot family already established by calendar/toast.
provenance.trigger-disabled-opacity: Button.css .saltButton:disabled { opacity: 0.4 } — a flat literal, density- and mode-invariant.
provenance.popup-bg / popup-fg: MenuPanel.css background: var(--salt-container-primary-background) -> palette-background-primary -> snow rgb(255,255,255)/jet rgb(16,24,32). Items inherit color from MenuItem.css's own content-primary-foreground -> black/white (same value, cited again at item-fg since the popup itself sets no color rule of its own — MenuPanel.css has no `color` property).
provenance.popup-border: MenuPanel.css border: var(--salt-size-fixed-100) solid var(--salt-selectable-borderColor-selected) -> next/characteristics/selectable.css --salt-selectable-borderColor-selected: var(--salt-palette-accent) -> next/palette/accent.css --salt-palette-accent: var(--salt-color-blue-500), IDENTICAL under both [data-mode] blocks (the SAME mode-invariant accent token checkbox.salt.json's own 'accent' provenance entry already resolved) -> foundations/color.css blue-500-rgb -> rgb(0,120,207). A genuinely blue-tinted popup frame, not a neutral one — a real Salt characteristic, not a simplification.
provenance.popup-shape: MenuPanel.css border-radius: var(--salt-palette-corner, 0) -> the UNSUFFIXED corner stop, next/palette/corner.css [data-corner="rounded"] -> curve-150 -> foundations/curve.css, the SAME rounder-than-controls stop dialog.salt.json's own panel-shape already used (3/6/9/12px by density — not modelled here per-density for brevity beyond the medium default reused across densities in this column's own trigger-shape family; the panel uses its OWN, rounder corner-150 stop, cited directly per density is out of scope creep for this row and the single reused value below is flagged as density-approximated).
provenance.popup-shadow: MenuPanel.css box-shadow: var(--salt-overlayable-shadow-popout) -> next/characteristics/overlayable.css -> next/palette/shadow.css --salt-shadow-mediumLow, the SAME slot/value select.salt.json/tabs.salt.json/tooltip.salt.json/toast.salt.json all reuse verbatim (docs/foundations/elevation.md).
provenance.popup-padding: CONFIRMED OFF — MenuPanel.css declares no padding property on the panel itself (the .saltMenuPanel-container rule, the class MenuPanelBase.tsx renders, is display:flex/flex-direction:column/gap only, defined in MenuPanel.css — see popup-gap), no padding.
provenance.popup-gap: MenuPanel.css's own .saltMenuPanel-container rule (rendered by MenuPanelBase.tsx): gap: var(--salt-spacing-fixed-100) -> foundations/spacing.css --salt-spacing-fixed-100: 1px, a FIXED (density-invariant) spacing unit, distinct from the density-scaled spacing-100 every other gap in this column uses.
provenance.popup-min-width: MenuPanel.css min-width: 10em — a literal em value, not a Salt token; recorded as-is (10em), density- and mode-invariant by construction (em-relative, not px).
provenance.popup-zindex: MenuPanel.css z-index: var(--salt-zIndex-flyover) -> docs/foundations/layers.md flyover = 1500, the SAME slot every prior popup component in this pipeline (select/tabs/tooltip/toast) already cites.
provenance.item-bg / item-bg-hover / item-open-bg: MenuItem.css background: var(--salt-selectable-background) -> next/characteristics/selectable.css --salt-selectable-background: transparent (rest). :hover/:focus-visible -> --salt-selectable-background-hover: var(--salt-palette-accent-weakest) -> blue-100 rgb(234,246,255) light / rgb(0,23,54) dark (the SAME token calendar.salt.json's own 'interaction-hover' already resolved, reused verbatim here). The submenu-trigger's OWN 'open' highlight (.saltCascadingMenuItem-menuItemBlurSelected / MenuItem's own -blurActive class) uses --salt-selectable-background-selected: var(--salt-palette-accent-weaker) -> blue-200 rgb(199,222,255) light / rgb(0,45,89) dark — a DIFFERENT, stronger slot from plain hover, matching calendar's own 'interaction-selected'.
provenance.item-fg / item-fg-disabled: MenuItem.css color: var(--salt-content-primary-foreground) -> black/white. Disabled: [aria-disabled="true"] { color: var(--salt-content-primary-foreground-disabled) } -> next/characteristics/content.css -> palette-foreground-primary-disabled -> foundations/alpha.css black-40a/white-40a = rgba(...,0.4) — Salt recolours the disabled item rather than reducing opacity uniformly, the reason style.item.opacity@disabled is 'off' for this column (its real disabled treatment is a colour swap, not an opacity multiply, and this column keeps that distinction honest rather than approximating with an opacity number that would also incorrectly dim the background).
provenance.item-padding / item-gap / item-min-heigh: MenuItem.css: padding: calc(spacing-100+spacing-25) spacing-100; gap: spacing-100; min-height: calc(size-base+spacing-100) — ALL by density. min-height values (24/36/48/60px) are IDENTICAL to toast.salt.json's own item-min-height (Toast.css and MenuItem.css derive this the same way).
provenance.item-shape: CONFIRMED OFF — MenuItem.css declares no border-radius of its own (the item fills the panel's own rectangular row, no independent rounding).
provenance.type-body / type-label: characteristics/text.css: body role (regular weight) drives MenuItem's own text AND (per the trigger-font provenance) the trigger's action-role text at identical numeric values; MenuGroup's own label uses --salt-text-label-fontSize/-fontWeight-strong(semiBold=600)/-fontFamily/-lineHeight — a DIFFERENT, bolder weight from the item's own body-regular text, by density.
provenance.separator-color: CascadingMenuItem.css .saltCascadingMenuItem-menuItemDivider { border-bottom: var(--salt-size-fixed-100) solid var(--salt-separable-secondary-borderColor) } -> next/characteristics/separable.css --salt-separable-secondary-borderColor: var(--salt-palette-alpha-contrast-medium) -> next/palette/alpha.css black-30a/white-30a -> rgba(0,0,0,0.3)/rgba(255,255,255,0.3) (same -Na chain as trigger-bg-hover/-active, one stop stronger).
provenance.separator-margin: OFF — CascadingMenuItem.css sets no margin on the `<div role="separator">` itself (it is a full-bleed border-bottom line inside the item's own box, not a standalone spaced rule); this column's own real mechanism does not map cleanly onto a standalone separator element's margin, so the row is left off with this note rather than approximated. A REGISTRY DEFAULT (see style.separator.margin's own policy=default handling) applies uniformly for this column too, per rule 14 (a default-policy row must never resolve to off) — the skeleton renders the registry default margin regardless of this column's own structural difference.
provenance.group-label-fg / group-label-padding: MenuGroup.css label: color: var(--salt-content-secondary-foreground) -> palette-foreground-secondary -> gray-700 rgb(76,81,87) light / gray-300 rgb(177,181,185) dark (the SAME slot dialog.salt.json's own fg-secondary already resolved). padding: calc(spacing-100+spacing-25) spacing-100 — the IDENTICAL formula to item-padding, by density.
provenance.icon-size: docs/foundations/sizes.md size-icon = 10/12/14/16 by density (unclamped — MenuItem.css has no icon-specific min-height clamp the way Toast.css does), the icon inherits currentColor from the item's own text colour (no dedicated icon-color rule in MenuItem.css or CascadingMenuItem.css).
